entries.title: Psalms 37:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, and be not envious of them that work unrighteousness;

entries.title: Psalms 37:2
segments: for they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and fade as the green herb.

entries.title: Psalms 37:3
segments: Confide in Jehovah, and do good; dwell in the land, and feed on faithfulness;

entries.title: Psalms 37:4
segments: and delight thyself in Jehovah, and he will give thee the desires of thy heart.

entries.title: Psalms 37:5
segments: Commit thy way unto Jehovah, and rely upon him: he will bring [it] to pass;

entries.title: Psalms 37:6
segments: and he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 37:7
segments: ¶Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him that prospereth in his way, because of the man that bringeth mischievous devices to pass.

entries.title: Psalms 37:8
segments: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself: it [would be] only to do evil.

entries.title: Psalms 37:9
segments: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait on Jehovah, they shall possess the land.

entries.title: Psalms 37:10
segments: For yet a little while, and the wicked is not; and thou considerest his place, but he is not.

entries.title: Psalms 37:11
segments: But the meek shall possess the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of prosperity.

entries.title: Psalms 37:12
segments: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth his teeth against him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:13
segments: The Lord laugheth at him; for he seeth that his day is coming.

entries.title: Psalms 37:14
segments: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the afflicted and needy, to slay those that are upright in [the] way:

entries.title: Psalms 37:15
segments: their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

entries.title: Psalms 37:16
segments: The little that the righteous hath is better than the abundance of many wicked;

entries.title: Psalms 37:17
segments: for the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 37:18
segments: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever:

entries.title: Psalms 37:19
segments: they shall not be ashamed in the time of evil, and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 37:20
segments: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume, like smoke shall they consume away.

entries.title: Psalms 37:21
segments: ¶The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; but the righteous is gracious and giveth:

entries.title: Psalms 37:22
segments: for those blessed of him shall possess the land, and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:23
segments: The steps of a man are established by Jehovah, and he delighteth in his way:

entries.title: Psalms 37:24
segments: though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down, for Jehovah upholdeth his hand.

entries.title: Psalms 37:25
segments: I have been young, and now am old, and I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread:

entries.title: Psalms 37:26
segments: all the day he is gracious and lendeth, and his seed shall be a blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 37:27
segments: Depart from evil, and do good, and dwell for evermore;

entries.title: Psalms 37:28
segments: for Jehovah loveth judgment, and will not forsake his saints: They are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:29
segments: The righteous shall possess the land, and dwell therein for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:30
segments: The mouth of the righteous proffereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh judgment;

entries.title: Psalms 37:31
segments: the law of his God is in his heart; his goings shall not slide.

entries.title: Psalms 37:32
segments: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him:

entries.title: Psalms 37:33
segments: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 37:34
segments: ¶Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, and he will exalt thee to possess the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 37:35
segments: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading like a green tree in its native soil:

entries.title: Psalms 37:36
segments: but he passed away, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, but he was not found.

entries.title: Psalms 37:37
segments: Mark the perfect, and behold the upright, for the end of [that] man is peace;

entries.title: Psalms 37:38
segments: but the transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:39
segments: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 37:40
segments: And Jehovah will help them and deliver them: he will deliver them from the wicked, and save them; for they trust in him.
